name: Vane
description: Vane (formerly Perplexica) is a self-hosted AI answering engine in the style of Perplexity. It searches the web through SearXNG and answers with cited sources, using a local LLM through Ollama or a cloud provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Groq.

notes.text: Vane has no login: anyone who reaches port 3000 can read the chat history and the provider API keys. Keep it on a trusted network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
The first visit opens the setup screen: add an AI provider and pick a chat and an embedding model. Ollama on another host must listen on 0.0.0.0 and is entered as http://<ollama-ip>:11434.
